head: 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e
notes: No shell language guide exists in context/rules (go, python, sql only), so style was judged against the surrounding scripts and the injected ACTION-REVIEW-QUALITY entries. Many candidate claims in this chunk were already in the known ledger and were suppressed (e.g. MIN-86 duplicated profile parsing, NIT-100/101/102/118-122/175/177/178, NIT-27/28/30/31/32/33/36-r2, correctness-NIT-20-r1 'Non-developer' comment). Suspected cross-chunk issue for the station: cmd/hooks/skill-invoke-gate.sh:52 tells the lane to invoke the skill '(bare, no args)', but the railroad-review skill's lane contract (SKILL-RAILROADREVIEW-CTX-002a) requires args="lane:<direction>" so the injector serves the direction slice. A lane that follows the deny reason would get the unmapped fallback context. Whether the skill or the hook is authoritative sits outside this chunk.

findings.claim: The new test file builds a t_slash transcript fixture ("/railroad-review do it" without a REQUIRE-SKILL marker) that no test ever reads; test_prompt_start_slash_counts builds its own $t fixture instead, so the variable is dead code that suggests a marker-less slash case is covered when it is not.
findings.fix: Delete the t_slash line (42), or add an assertion that uses it (e.g. a marker-less slash first message stays silent).
findings.evidence: Re-read cmd/tests/test_skill_invoke_gate.sh in full at 1f725ce: t_slash is assigned at line 42 and written to $TMP/slash.jsonl; `git grep -n t_slash 1f725ce` returns only line 42. test_prompt_start_slash_counts (89-96) writes its own $TMP/slash_marker.jsonl. No other function references $t_slash or slash.jsonl.

findings.claim: This diff adds a fourth smine-nightly stage (Stage 3 orchestrate: registry->additionalDirectories append, /smine-orchestrate merge of the run branch into main, prune) gated by the new ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE / casual-audience switch, plus SMINE_DEV_MODE threading, but the routines operations README — which the diff did edit (SMINE_SUBAGENTS line 179, skill-eval rows) — still describes smine-nightly as 'three stages, one publish' ending on a local branch, and documents neither ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE nor SMINE_DEV_MODE.
findings.fix: Extend the smine-nightly row at routines/README.md:14 with the orchestrate stage ('then /smine-orchestrate <run branch> when ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE=1 or the profile audience is casual') and add ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE and SMINE_DEV_MODE to the env-knob list next to SMINE_SUBAGENTS (line 179).
findings.evidence: Re-read routines/smine-nightly/run.sh at 1f725ce lines 38-47 (dev_mode, orchestrate, auto_apply gating) and 293-340 (Stage 3 orchestrate). Re-read routines/README.md in full: line 14 still says 'three stages, one publish'; `git grep -n -e ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE -e SMINE_DEV_MODE 1f725ce -- cmd routines docs README.md internal` finds the variables only in the two run.sh scripts and the bootstrap test, never in a README. Distinct from known code-style-NIT-32-r2 (run.sh header comment) and correctness-MIN-19-r1 (skill-eval-fexplore row).

findings.claim: The new bootstrap wrapper's header 'Env:' list names only the BOOTSTRAP_* variables, but the script also reads SMINE_DEV_MODE (64), SMINE_AGENTS (99), SMINE_APPLY_CAP (108), ROUTINE_MODEL, ROUTINE_PERMISSION_MODE and ROUTINE_MAX_BUDGET_USD (136-139); an operator reading the header cannot discover the dev-mode override the test suite exercises (test_bootstrap_wrapper.sh:81).
findings.fix: Append the honored overrides to the header: '# Also honors SMINE_DEV_MODE, SMINE_AGENTS, SMINE_APPLY_CAP, ROUTINE_MODEL, ROUTINE_PERMISSION_MODE, ROUTINE_MAX_BUDGET_USD (nightly defaults).'
findings.evidence: Re-read cmd/bootstrap/run.sh in full at 1f725ce: header lines 9-11 list BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE, BOOTSTRAP_SINCE, BOOTSTRAP_N, BOOTSTRAP_EXTRA_PROMPT, BOOTSTRAP_DRY_RUN only; lines 64, 99, 108, 136-139 read the six unlisted variables. Not among the known-ledger rows for this file (correctness-BLK-22, code-style-MIN-86, tests-NIT-13, tests-NIT-56).
